title: The Algebras of Design
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Stiny develops a common algebraic language for drawings, models and symbolic descriptions. It explains why shapes can have recognizable parts that are absent from their stored list of maximal elements.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Publisher PDF: shape representation and operations, grammar mechanism, emergence and indeterminacy examples, concluding cross-domain discussion. Selected technical sections and examples were reviewed. The detailed classification of indeterminacy was read for context, not independently proved.
